### [`cron-auth.ts`](../../lib/security/cron-auth.ts)

- `bearerUnauthorized` _function_: `null` when the request carries `Bearer <process.env[envName]>`, the response to return otherwise. An unset secret disables the route with a 503 rather than accepting `Bearer undefined`, which anybody can send.
- `cronUnauthorized` _function_: The gate every `/api/cron/*` route opens with; see `bearerUnauthorized`.

### [`turnstile-actions.ts`](../../lib/security/turnstile-actions.ts)

- `TURNSTILE_ACTIONS` _const_: The actions this app renders Turnstile widgets with.
- Types: `TurnstileAction`

### [`turnstile.ts`](../../lib/security/turnstile.ts)

- `verifyTurnstile` _function_: Verifies a Turnstile token for the form it was solved on; a failure carries a reason to log.
- Types: `TurnstileResult`, `TurnstileCheck`

### [`vercel-webhook.ts`](../../lib/security/vercel-webhook.ts)

- `vercelSignatureValid` _function_: Whether `signature` is Vercel's `x-vercel-signature` for `rawBody`: the hex HMAC-SHA1 of the raw body under the webhook's secret. It has to be the text as received, because re-serialised JSON no longer hashes to what Vercel signed.
